errors.text_span: Die Linie für 2025 ist mittelblau und verläuft im ersten Jahresdrittel im Bereich um die 30‑ bis 40‑%‑Gitterlinien ... und steigt danach bis in den Herbst in den Bereich oberhalb der 70‑%‑Gitterlinie.
errors.evidence: The 2025 line in the figure is the light-blue line that starts around 60% in January and is only around the mid-30% range by March; the description incorrectly says it is 30–40% in the first third of the year and then rises above 70% in autumn, which is not shown.
In the figure, 2025 is shown by a lighter blue line, distinct from the darker blue 2024 line; calling it 'mittelblau' misidentifies the visual mapping.
